smell: `CountryOption.callingCode` is required as `S.String`, but construction from `countries-list` fills missing phone metadata with an empty string via `O.getOrElse(() => "")`. That encodes absence as a string sentinel inside a schema-modeled option record.
proposedTarget: Represent missing phone prefix data as Option, for example `callingCode: S.OptionFromOptionalKey(S.String).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)`, or introduce a named `CountryOptionFromCountriesList` transform that maps an absent/empty phone array to `O.none()` before constructing `CountryOption`. Renderers can then project `O.none` to an empty label only at the combobox display boundary. Verified APIs: `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8668` for `S.OptionFromOptionalKey` and `packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/SchemaUtils/withConstructorDefaults.ts:46` for `SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault`.

exception.reason: CountryOption is exported display/search data derived from the third-party countries-list dataset; S5 already settled this as a permissive UI boundary. Changing callingCode to Option would alter the public countryOptions/CountryOptionContent shape and ripple through JSX display consumers outside the intended schema-default absorption.
exception.boundary: third-party countries-list display/search data; public UI option shape

smell: The detector sees explicit `Str.trim` / `Str.toLowerCase` protocol normalization before URL safety checks.

exception.reason: This is a trust-boundary URL sanitizer. The SPEC carves out URL/security input hardening from schema-crispening rewrites, and the normalization is part of the guard that blocks unsafe protocols.

smell: The detector sees `DateTime.DateTime | null` and null returns for empty or invalid date input.

exception.reason: The method implements the MUI X date adapter contract, where `null` represents empty or invalid date parsing. Replacing it with Option would break the adapter surface instead of crispening an owned domain model.

smell: The detector sees a component-level `return null` when no chart color configuration needs a generated style tag.

exception.reason: This is the React render-null convention for omitting a subtree, not absence in schema-modeled data. The chart CSS selector sanitizer in the same file is also a trust-boundary concern.

smell: The detector sees hook-level defaults such as `currentOptions.modelId ?? defaultModelId` and SDK option compaction that removes undefined microphone constraints.

exception.reason: These defaults adapt React hook options into the ElevenLabs SDK call shape. The values are not persisted domain records, and preserving SDK optional-object semantics is more important than moving them into local schemas.
exception.boundary: third-party SDK adapter / React hook options
